subject: Television & Streaming
title: AI and the Future of Content
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on AI and the Future of Content.

hook.text: AI can now generate scripts, edit trailers, and create synthetic actors.

buildup.text: Studios are already using AI to analyze scripts, predict hits, and optimize marketing campaigns.

discovery.text: Some companies have tested AI-generated shows. The results were technically functional but emotionally hollow.

twist.text: The 2023 strikes won protections, but AI improves every year. The line between tool and replacement keeps moving.

climax.text: The question isn't whether AI will change entertainment—it's whether audiences will accept what it creates.

punchline.text: Machines can write a script. They can't feel why it matters.

quiz.question: What concern did the 2023 Hollywood strikes raise about AI?
options: AI could be used to replace human writers and actors
AI couldn't produce content fast enough
